name: hold
summary: stop the operator from proposing new operations for a claim; nothing on the machine changes
description:
A hold tells the operator to propose no new operation for the claim (no
install, no reinstall, no BIOS or firmware change). It changes nothing on the
machine, and operations that already exist are not changed: approve or delete
those yourself. The reason is stored on the claim, so that others can see why.

Claims usually live in namespace default, so that is the default here.

flags.name: context
flags.usage: kubeconfig context to use (default: the current context)

flags.name: kubeconfig
flags.usage: kubeconfig file (default: $KUBECONFIG, then ~/.kube/config, then the in-cluster account)

flags.name: reason
flags.usage: why, for the people who see the hold (stored on the claim)
